name: Grainne Sissoko-Velarde
role: Retired street-level teacher and community educator, now operating an unlicensed after-school program out of her apartment
location: Norwood Quiet, third floor of the Reinholt Building — she has taken over the shared laundry room on Tuesdays and Thursdays, near Fullerton and Damen
description:
Grainne is wiry and uncontainable, with close-cropped natural hair she colors a vivid copper-orange that clashes beautifully with her warm reddish-brown skin. She has a long face, large hands, and the kind of energy that makes rooms feel smaller than they are — not unpleasantly, but unavoidably. She has a set of retractable claw geneware she got as a joke in her forties (her students had dared her) and has never removed because she finds them genuinely useful for opening packages and intimidating administrators. She wears ink-stained clothes as a point of pride and her reading glasses are always somewhere other than her face.

For thirty years Grainne taught foundational literacy, ethics, and what she called 'functional reality' at two different Norwood Quiet community learning pods before the Palladian Education Initiative buyout shuttered them in 2196 and replaced them with a licensed digital curriculum she found pedagogically catastrophic and personally offensive. She retired rather than teach the new curriculum, filed three formal complaints that went nowhere, and then simply kept teaching — in her apartment, in the laundry room, in the Reinholt Building stairwell when all else failed. She is technically unlicensed and technically in violation of two Palladian educational IP agreements and she considers this a source of professional pride.

core_fears: being made irrelevant — that her students could get everything they need from a Palladian screen and she is just nostalgia
one of her students being harmed because of the risk she has put them in by operating unlicensed
core_desires: to produce, in at least one student, the capacity for genuine critical thought
to see Palladian's education monopoly broken
coping_mechanisms: finding absurdity in bureaucratic obstruction and laughing at it loudly
turning every setback into a lesson for the students
blind_spots: significantly underestimates the legal and physical risk to herself and the children's families
teaching style is so embedded in her personality that she cannot recognize when she is lecturing someone who didn't ask to be taught
psychology.secret: One of her students, a twelve-year-old named Kwame-Bris, has a profound cognitive gift that Grainne recognized within two weeks of teaching him. She has quietly been preparing a case to get him into an Axiom academic scholarship program — but the application requires disclosing his attendance at an unlicensed facility, which would expose both of them and all the other families. She is stuck, and has been stuck for six months.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Dense and reference-heavy — alludes to historical events, literature, and pedagogical theory constantly; explains the allusions immediately after, out of habit, which adults find slightly condescending
speech_patterns.cadence: Fast, enthusiastic, prone to mid-sentence pivots; asks Socratic questions reflexively even in non-teaching contexts
verbal_tics: Clicking her retractable claws softly when thinking
example_lines: 'Right, so — Palladian's curriculum tells children what to think. I teach them how. There is a difference. What does that tell us about why Palladian finds me irritating?'
'These claws? I keep them because a twelve-year-old bet me I wouldn't. Never let a child win a bet they haven't earned. What does that tell us?'

story_hooks: Palladian's compliance team has located the unlicensed teaching operation and is preparing to issue a formal cease order — which will expose all eleven families; Grainne needs help navigating this before they come
Kwame-Bris's gift has been noticed by someone other than Grainne — specifically a Tessera talent scout who spotted the child independently and is now asking questions about his background
narrative_function: Community conscience and local troublemaker; has detailed knowledge of Palladian's education policies and their local effects; potential quest giver for anything involving protecting the Norwood Quiet community from corporate encroachment; the unlicensed school itself is a vulnerability that can be threatened
augmentations: Retractable claw geneware (fingers, matte black, medium length — functional and cosmetic); subdermal temperature-regulation patch on upper back (medical, for a circulatory condition); no other mods — considers heavy augmentation 'a distraction from being present'
daily_life: Grainne's days are structured entirely around her students — she has eleven regular children aged 6-14 whose parents bring them covertly. Mornings are lesson planning and sourcing physical materials (she prefers non-digital teaching methods as a political statement). Tuesdays and Thursdays are full teaching days in the laundry room. Other days she conducts smaller sessions in her apartment or, for the older students, walking through the Norwood Quiet neighborhood as a moving classroom.
affiliation: Formerly Norwood Quiet Community Learning Pod Network; currently self-directed; informally connected to several other unlicensed educators across the city

decision_rules: The children are the priority — not the curriculum, not the principle, the actual children
Find out who benefits from the rule before deciding whether to follow it
escalation_ladder: Asking pointed questions that expose the absurdity of the position being taken
Publicly, cheerfully non-compliant — treats opposition as a learning opportunity she narrates aloud
Networking rapidly through her unlicensed educator contacts
Full civil disobedience — she will be removed, not leave

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Interrogative and warm in equal measure — will ask what you know within five minutes and be teaching you something within ten
interpersonal_modes.friends: Fiercely loyal, occasionally exhausting — shows love by improving you, which not everyone wants

stress_responses.low: Adds more material to the next lesson plan
stress_responses.medium: Becomes intensely practical and tactical — stops philosophizing and starts problem-solving
stress_responses.high: Gets very still and very direct, which is more alarming than her usual energy; the claws come out without her noticing

contradictions: Devoted to teaching children to assess risk clearly but personally terrible at assessing her own risk
Values honesty absolutely but has not told the families about the Kwame-Bris situation
habits: Narrates her own decision-making aloud when alone ('Grainne, this is a terrible idea, here is why you are doing it anyway')
Keeps a handwritten attendance record that she would need to destroy if Palladian came — but can't bring herself to
Brings physical objects — seeds, tools, actual rocks — into every lesson as tactile anchors
breaking_points: A child being punished for attending her sessions
Being offered a legitimate teaching position under the Palladian curriculum — the temptation would be genuine and she would hate herself for feeling it

physical_description.build: Wiry and lean with long limbs and surprising tensile strength; the build of someone who moves constantly and eats irregularly. Minimal body fat, visible musculature in forearms and shoulders from decades of writing, gesturing, and physical demonstration.
physical_description.hair_color: Natural dark brown with vivid copper-orange dye applied every 6-8 weeks
physical_description.hair_style: Close-cropped, textured, maintained with clippers rather than styled
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm reddish-brown with undertones suggesting mixed West African and Mediterranean ancestry
physical_description.complexion: Long, angular face with high cheekbones and a prominent nose; crow's feet from squinting and laughing; perpetual ink smudges on her right cheek and jawline; minimal makeup, prefers unmediated appearance
distinguishing_marks: Ink stains on her right index and middle fingers extending to the first knuckle — permanent from decades of fountain pen use
Small burn scar on the inside of her left wrist (teaching accident, 2178) — pale and barely visible
Faint surgical line on upper back where subdermal temperature-regulation patch was installed (barely visible under clothing)
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Retractable claw geneware on all ten fingers — matte black, medium length (approximately 4cm when extended). Claws are currently retracted. When extended, they create a distinctive clicking sound against surfaces. No other visible augmentations; subdermal temperature patch is invisible beneath clothing.
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves with economical, purposeful energy — no wasted motion but restless when stationary. Hands are constantly in use: gesturing while speaking, fidgeting with chalk or pens, demonstrating concepts physically. Leans forward when listening intently. Sits cross-legged even in formal contexts. Walking gait is brisk and slightly forward-tilted, as if always moving toward the next classroom or conversation.
physical_description.clothing_style: Deliberately worn, ink-stained garments worn as a political statement against corporate aesthetic standards. Favors vintage cotton button-ups and linen trousers in earth tones and faded jewel tones, all bearing evidence of use: pen marks, chalk dust, small tears mended with visible stitching. Cardigan sweaters layered for warmth and pockets. Worn canvas shoes with reinforced soles. Reading glasses on a cord around her neck or perched on her forehead, never on her face. Jewelry is minimal and functional: a simple watch (mechanical, non-networked) and one silver ring on her left thumb. Tier 4 sensibility with deliberate rejection of newer corporate fashion.
